Hi Emily, I'm your health assistant. You can ask me about your symptoms, medications, or recent lab results. How can I help today?

I've had a mild headache since yesterday. Should I be worried?

A mild headache lasting a day is usually not an emergency. A few things that may help:

  • Stay hydrated and rest in a quiet, dark room
  • Avoid screens for extended periods
  • Over-the-counter pain relief if you have no contraindications

Seek care promptly if the headache is sudden and severe, or comes with fever, vision changes, or confusion.
